policy: Evidence-based diagnostics; pattern matching is not proof of root cause; no autonomous fixes or external commands.

cases.title: Hugo theme config schema mismatch
cases.regex: dateFormat.*type string|colorScheme.*type string|can't evaluate field .* in type string
cases.advice: Check theme version and params shape; restore nested tables expected by active theme

cases.title: Hugo template or partial missing
cases.regex: partial .*not found|template .* not defined|failed to render pages|render of .* failed
cases.advice: Inspect the FIRST nested Hugo template/partial/Sass error and correct the actual file. Validate template override precedence and theme version; if Sass mixes incompatible numeric units, inspect calc() or syntax rather than assuming a missing partial. CI signal is not a proven root cause (Fix Bug 2026 PR #124).

cases.title: Hugo Go module resolution
cases.regex: failed to download modules|module .*not found|module declares its path as|unknown revision|checksum mismatch
cases.advice: Check go.mod, go.sum, module path/version and network; never bypass checksum verification

cases.title: Dart Sass missing or incompatible
cases.regex: no Dart Sass binary|TOCSS-DART|unexpected EOF when executing .sass.
cases.advice: Install official Dart Sass executable required by Hugo and verify PATH; not just npm sass CLI

cases.title: Hugo version mismatch
cases.advice: Compare Hugo Extended version with theme module minimum and action setup

cases.title: Missing generated assets or resources
cases.regex: missing-asset|resource .*not found|failed to execute resource|get resource .*nil
cases.advice: Check asset pipeline, image/resource paths, GitHub Pages baseURL and pathprefix

cases.title: JavaScript parse error
cases.advice: Check first parser error and the changed script/event/prompt assembly. Run node --check on changed JS/MJS (and validate inline scripts separately), make a new correcting commit, then rerun Bug Checker. Never retry unchanged deterministic syntax errors as a fix. See Fix Bug 2026 PR #54/#227.

cases.title: Expected route missing
cases.advice: Inspect page front matter, drafts, menu links, permalink config and published public directory

cases.title: GitHub Actions permission restriction
cases.regex: Resource not accessible by integration|403 Forbidden|owner marked spam|workflow is not permitted
cases.advice: Inspect token scopes, repository restrictions and account-level blocks; do not assume quota issue

cases.title: GitHub Pages deployment error
cases.regex: deploy-pages.*failed|Failed to deploy|Pages build and deployment|Artifact not found
cases.advice: Inspect deploy job logs, Pages environment, artifact paths and permissions

cases.title: Temporary network/API quota
cases.regex: 429 Too Many Requests|rate limit exceeded|connection reset|TLS handshake timeout|503 Service Unavailable|502 Bad Gateway
cases.advice: Retry bounded with backoff; use API snapshot/cache fallback when appropriate

cases.title: PR branch conflict
cases.advice: Compare latest main, resolve conflict preserving newer content; rerun Bug Checker

postmortem_schema.evidence_rule: Verified cause, solution and outcome required; never derive root cause from CI success alone.

series_casebook.title: Fix Bug 2026 — evidence-calibrated CI and product repair lessons
series_casebook.policy: Lessons derived from the eight authored Fix Bug 2026 posts. These are read-only investigation playbooks; casebook references do not independently prove root cause or warrant automatic source changes.
series_casebook.classification_note: ci-recovery = earlier failing and later passing CI on different commits reported by source article; engineering-postmortem = code-backed change and passing CI without proven CI red→green. Never automatically classify an unverified root cause.

lessons.title: JavaScript syntax when building AI Series Studio
lessons.observed_signal: The PR blog identifies JavaScript parse error in an earlier failed Bug Checker run; the PR includes a follow-up fix for prompt concatenation.
lessons.reusable_action: Run `node --check` on changed standalone JS; inspect first syntax failure and the concatenation near changed prompt strings before rerunning on a new commit SHA.
lessons.regression_check: Confirm latest SHA passes JS checks and Bug Checker; do not treat a retry of unchanged source as a repair.
lessons.evidence_limit: CI red→green is documented; no individual faulty line is proven solely by the posts.

lessons.title: Hugo render/Sass mixed-unit expression triage
lessons.observed_signal: The series report classified a Hugo template/partial signal; PR history also contains a change replacing a mixed-unit Sass min expression with CSS calc.
lessons.reusable_action: Read the first nested Hugo/Sass error, confirm the actual stylesheet/template location, check mixed-unit Sass math and prefer valid CSS `calc()` where appropriate; do not assume the classifier title is the root cause.
lessons.regression_check: Run the Hugo build and route audit on a fresh PR revision; verify responsive layout where CSS was changed.
lessons.evidence_limit: Classifier label is generic; Sass-specific explanation is inferred from named fix commit, not independently verified from raw failed log.

lessons.title: CMS V2 Integration event JavaScript syntax
lessons.observed_signal: An earlier Bug Checker was classified as a JavaScript parse error; the PR records a repair to an Integration status event.
lessons.reusable_action: Parse all modified Integration/CMS V2 scripts with `node --check`; inspect braces, event handler syntax and script load order; do not retry deterministic parse errors unchanged.
lessons.regression_check: Run Bug Checker on the corrected head; then smoke-test Integration status updates in browser.
lessons.evidence_limit: Only signature and red→green runs are substantiated by the series; runtime behavior requires separate browser validation.

lessons.title: Malformed GitHub Actions YAML and brittle CMS router test
lessons.observed_signal: The PR reports literal backslash-n escapes embedded in an Actions YAML step and a fragile router-function parsing test.
lessons.reusable_action: Ensure workflow YAML uses real line breaks and parse it with a proper YAML/Actions linter; test the complete router function boundary without fragile regex escape assumptions.
lessons.regression_check: Check that GitHub can schedule jobs at all, then run `node scripts/test-cms-v2-router.mjs` and current Bug Checker.
lessons.evidence_limit: Source PR cites a prior run, but the published article did not establish an independently linked failed→passing CI revision pair.

lessons.title: CMS V2 viewport overflow and sticky controls
lessons.observed_signal: PR description documents hidden Markdown source min-height producing an oversized editor and an incorrectly scoped sticky toolbar; browser measurements are reported by the author.
lessons.reusable_action: Scope the fix to the CMS V2 workspace. Inspect hidden source min-height and positioning, choose a bounded scroll container, make sticky toolbar relative to that container, and keep mobile natural flow.
lessons.regression_check: Test desktop and mobile viewport heights, long-editor scrolling, toolbar reachability, keyboard navigation and route navigation; CI alone cannot verify layout.
lessons.evidence_limit: The PR includes browser QA claims; the article itself has no confirmed failed CI run for this change.

lessons.title: Provider model discovery and actionable API failures
lessons.observed_signal: PR describes a model filter that excluded supported `preview` identifiers plus ambiguous authentication/quota/network errors.
lessons.reusable_action: When an AI integration exists, discover models by actual API-supported methods/capabilities instead of excluding all preview IDs; distinguish 400, 401/403, 404, 429 and network/CORS errors.
lessons.regression_check: Mock model discovery, unsupported model and throttling/auth conditions; validate with an authorized test key without exposing secrets. Do NOT reintroduce previously removed Gemini TTS UI.
lessons.evidence_limit: Product-fix report only; no prior failed CI run was established.

lessons.title: Late online speech voices overriding a local default
lessons.observed_signal: PR describes Web Speech `getVoices()` loading local voices before Microsoft Hoai My Online Natural.
lessons.reusable_action: Listen for `voiceschanged`, refresh with a finite retry budget, rank Hoai My → other Vietnamese Online/Natural → Vietnamese local, update selection, and preserve user manual choice.
lessons.regression_check: Test local-first voice enumeration, late online voice arrival, no Hoai My, repeated events and manual override on the target browser.
lessons.evidence_limit: Browser engine/platform-dependent behavior cannot be guaranteed by passing CI.

lessons.title: Voiceover metadata dates and UI debris leaking into TTS
lessons.observed_signal: PR describes publication dates, read-time stats and pasted UI fragments bypassing a line-only filter and being converted to spoken numbers.
lessons.reusable_action: Clean HTML controls, metadata and calendar dates before number-to-Vietnamese-word and phonetic conversion; remove orphan connectors while preserving meaningful durations and facts as explicitly required.
lessons.regression_check: Run `node --test scripts/test-voiceover-preprocess.mjs` on inline and standalone date formats, labels, sources, `GPU`, `3D`, and real expressions like `30 năm`.
lessons.evidence_limit: CI green and PR description do not independently establish production browser correctness.
